name: Speech of introduction
purpose: Prepare the audience to listen to another speaker.
moves: Explain why this speaker matters to this audience
End with the speaker's name and a welcome
avoid: Giving the speaker's speech for them

name: Speech of presentation
purpose: Present an award or honor and explain why it is deserved.

name: Speech of dedication
purpose: Mark the opening or naming of a place or project.
moves: Honor those who made it possible
avoid: Technical details that belong in a report

name: Toast
purpose: Honor a person or occasion during a celebration.
moves: Connect to the person or event
Invite everyone to raise a glass

name: Eulogy or tribute
purpose: Honor someone who has died or is being remembered.
tone: Respectful, warm; light moments can be appropriate
moves: Share who the person was through specific stories
Offer comfort or a way to remember

name: Speech of farewell
purpose: Say goodbye when leaving or honoring someone who is leaving.

name: Commencement speech
purpose: Celebrate graduates and send them forward.
moves: Share a lesson through a story
avoid: Clichés with no story behind them
